name: Sample Pages 12 — Employment Detail Side Panel (Snapshots)
source: User-provided screenshot export from Figma (Sample Side-Panel Modal Detail - 2). Node ID not captured.
description: Same employment detail side panel as page-11, showing an in-review contract (V1 · Main) with the Snapshots tab active. Stage stepper: only step 1 (KA REVIEW) reached; steps 2-6 upcoming. Header action becomes a suggested next action ('Next: Edit Contract') split button. Snapshots tab: grouped snapshot timeline — 'MAIN RECORD' group strip, then snapshot rows (CR01-CR04) on a vertical dot timeline; 'REQUEST CHANGE #1' group strip below.
note: Same shell, panel-header, summary-bar and two-column layout as page-11. Differences: selected version card (V1 · Main, Current), stepper progress (step 1 only), header action, active tab (Snapshots (4)) and tab counts (Timeline (15)).

shell.note: Identical to page-11: right-anchored Panel MultiCard (1045px) over scrim.

summary-bar.note: Identical to page-11 candidate-summary-bar. Total tenure chip reads 'Total: 0 Years 1 Months 14 Days'.

employment-history.note: Same employment-history-tree as page-11. Single version card: 'V1 · Main' + 'Current' badge, contract number 638/PKWT-PTES/001/VI/2024, date range '01 Jul 2024 – 31 Dec 2024 (Ongoing)', role 'Marketing Specialist', salary 'IDR 9.500.000'. Card selected (brand.brand border).

contract-detail.description: Contract detail card for an in-review contract.

action.note: Suggested next action; label text in brand.brand

stage-stepper.note: Same element as page-11. Progress: step 1 'KA REVIEW' current (brand.brand); steps 2-6 (KAM, HOD, KA SEND, CANDIDATE, ACTIVE) upcoming (system.surface-strong circles, system.text-mute labels).

tab-snapshots.description: CUSTOM ELEMENT — grouped snapshot list on a vertical dot timeline. Group strip: full-width label row on system.surface-strong ('MAIN RECORD', 'REQUEST CHANGE #1') in text-styles.regular.label-sm, system.text-mute. Snapshot row: timeline dot column left (radio-style dot; latest/selected dot brand.brand, others system.border-medium; dotted connector line) + row card (stroke.thin system.border-soft border, corner-radius.md): document icon, snapshot code 'CR01' (text-styles.bold.body-sm, system.text-head), snapshot label ('Signed Version', 'Correction Upd...', 'Soft Edit Version', 'Final Version') in text-styles.regular.body-sm system.text-body, 'Digital' with file icon, signer indicator 'No'/'Yes' with person icon, timestamp '02 Jun 24 14:30' (text-styles.regular.label-sm, system.text-mute). Latest row: 'Latest' status-chip Success + selected dot.

customElementsRegistry.panel-detail-header: Candidate switcher + prev/next + collapse + close. (shared with page-11)
customElementsRegistry.candidate-summary-bar: Avatar + name + status/info chips. (shared with page-11)

customElementsRegistry.snapshot-timeline-list: Grouped snapshot rows on vertical dot timeline. Group strips on system.surface-strong; latest row gets Success 'Latest' chip.
